name: Camfetamine
summary: Camfetamine (N-methyl-3-phenyl-norbornan-2-amine) is a stimulant drug closely related to the appetite suppressant fencamfamine, being its N-methyl homologue. It has been sold as a designer drug following the banning of mephedrone and related substituted cathinone derivatives in many countries, and reportedly has slightly stronger stimulant effects than fencamfamine, but with correspondingly more severe side effects.

sideEffects.text: It has been sold as a designer drug following the banning of mephedrone and related substituted cathinone derivatives in many countries, and reportedly has slightly stronger stimulant effects than fencamfamine, but with correspondingly more severe side effects.

pharmacology.en: It has barely been studied. Its close relative fencamfamine raises dopamine and noradrenaline by releasing them and blocking their reuptake, and camfetamine is presumed to work in a similar way.
pharmacology.zh: 它幾乎沒有被研究過。它的近親 fencamfamine 會促使多巴胺與正腎上腺素釋放並阻斷其回收，一般推測 camfetamine 的作用方式類似。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它几乎没有被研究过。它的近亲 fencamfamine 会促使多巴胺与正肾上腺素释放并阻断其回收，一般推测 camfetamine 的作用方式类似。

fact.en: Its cage-like norbornane skeleton is the same two-ring carbon frame found in camphor, which is where the "cam" in camfetamine and its parent drug fencamfamine comes from.
fact.zh: 它籠狀的降莰烷骨架，和樟腦中的雙環碳架相同，這正是 camfetamine 以及其母藥 fencamfamine 名稱中「cam」的由來。
fact.zhHans: 它笼状的降莰烷骨架，和樟脑中的双环碳架相同，这正是 camfetamine 以及其母药 fencamfamine 名称中「cam」的由来。
